summary: Fitness Champs Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting the outcome of its annual general meeting held November 12, 2026 (Singapore time) at 55 Serangoon North Avenue 4. On the October 22, 2026 record date, 1,318,742 ordinary shares were outstanding (1,299,391 Class A at one vote each; 19,351 Class B at 50 votes each, or 967,550 votes). Holders of 36,617 Class A and all Class B shares, representing roughly 44.30% of total voting power, constituted quorum. Resolution 1 approves a conditional two-for-one share consolidation effective subject to Nasdaq notification. No transaction, stake, or price terms; watch only execution timing of the consolidation.
